description: This file contains general functions and class definitions for handling command-line arguments and configuration for the ECST application, specifically related to Nuvoton NPCX chips.

classes.name: EcstArgs
classes.description: Creates an arguments object for the ECST application, parsing command-line arguments and argument files, and populating chip-specific fields.

methods.name: _populate_chip_fields
methods.description: Populates chip-related fields based on the chip name, setting RAM address and size.

methods.name: _populate_args
methods.description: Populates ECST arguments from command-line or argument file inputs.

methods.name: _create_parser
methods.description: Creates an argument parser for command-line options.

methods.name: _file_to_line
methods.description: Reads a file and returns its contents as a single line string.

methods.name: _is_hex
methods.description: Checks if a string represents a hexadecimal number.

methods.name: exit_with_failure
methods.description: Prints a formatted error message and exits the program.
